_: The interview-page pattern. Copy this file to site/interviews/<slug>.json, fill every field, run node scripts/site/build-interview-pages.mjs, add interview-<slug>.html to site/pages.json (unlisted, group More), then generate.mjs. The page is static and sends nothing anywhere; the prompt runs in the reader's own assistant. Rules for the prompt: say what RiskMandate is in a few plain sentences using only what the site claims, one question at a time and short turns for voice, the reader controls the length ('skip', 'wrap up'), ask for candour explicitly, end with a structured written summary with fixed sections, and ask consent before it is shared. Files beginning with _ are not built.
audience: A short name for the group, for the page's eyebrow
title: Twenty minutes of your advice, by voice
who: One sentence, to the reader: who this page is for. Generic enough to send to anyone in the group.
why_you: One sentence: why they were chosen. Specific enough that they know.
learn: Three to six things we want to learn, so they know the questions before agreeing to answer them.
prompt: The whole prompt, exactly as it is to be copied, with its line breaks.

changes: every change made to the prompt, and why
